derivation: from H6117 (עָקַב); in the original sense, a knoll (as swelling up); in the denominative sense

occurrences.text: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low: and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough places plain:
The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked: who can know it?
Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity, and is polluted with blood.
